ticket.title: Improve keyboard access and edit wording in the conditions form
ticket.text:
Improve keyboard access and edit wording in the conditions form

Condition search results are clickable but can’t be reached or selected using the keyboard. The workspace also shows “Record condition” when editing an existing condition.

Can we make the search results keyboard accessible and update the title to reflect whether we’re recording or editing a condition?

#### Acceptance criteria:

- Search results support keyboard navigation and selection, with a visible focus indicator.
- Focus returns to the search input after selection, and the selected condition’s name remains in the input.
- Escape returns focus to the search input without selecting a result.
- The workspace shows “Record condition” when creating and “Edit condition” when editing.
- Mouse selection continues to work.
- Keyboard behavior and titles are validated on desktop and tablet.

Related: openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart#3645 addresses similar issues in visit notes.

understanding.intent: Enable keyboard navigation for condition search results and dynamic workspace titles for recording versus editing conditions.
